description: A date_histogram bucket aggregation over a date column. Must specify extended_bounds or hard_bounds so the bucket count is bounded.

field.description: Required. The date column to bucket.

calendar_interval.description: Optional. Calendar-aware interval (e.g. month, year). Mutually exclusive with fixed_interval.

fixed_interval.description: Optional. Fixed-duration interval (e.g. 30d, 12h). Mutually exclusive with calendar_interval.

min_doc_count.description: Optional. Minimum document count for a bucket to be returned.

offset.description: Optional. Shifts bucket boundaries by this duration.

time_zone.description: Optional. UTC offset or IANA zone used to compute bucket boundaries.

order.description: Optional. Bucket sort order — a {metric: "asc|desc"} object or an array of them.

missing.description: Optional. Bucket value assigned to documents missing field.

format.description: Optional. Date format applied to the bucket key in the response.
